# Arity mismatches (port finding, generated by port/tools/gametrial/arity.py)

A unit declares an address-named function with FEWER parameters than its definition takes, and calls it that
way. On the Wii this works when the missing argument happens to be in the right register already (often the
caller's own parameter, passed through in r3/r4). On x86 the callee reads garbage. extern "C" names are not
mangled, so no linker catches it. Found the hard way at mrender.cpp fn_802C8B70 -> fn_802CAD74 (texture id).

Fix in the decomp: give the declaration the real parameters and pass the value the code relies on (usually the
caller's parameter in the same position). Often matching-neutral (the value is already in the register), but
please verify each. Declarations with MORE parameters than the definition (240 sites) are harmless on x86 and
not listed.
